The '''devastation of Little Kessel''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The devastation==
{{Quote|No... ''No&mdash;! I can't stand it&mdash;!'' Let me ''stop!'' Don't make me do this any more&mdash;!''"<br />"''Kessel has only surrendered ''two'' of the hundreds of Rebels ''known'' to be on the planet&mdash;! You will ''destroy'' the planet or you will ''never'' see your daughter again!|Professor Renn Volz and Captain Bzorn|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Little Kessel]] was home to hundreds of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]] traveled to Little Kessel aboard the [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']] and demanded that all Rebels on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] be surrendered. When the government of Little Kessel refused, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tormented the planet with [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and cyclones.<ref name="TSKR" />
